warning_extension_binding.finding: The reconciled saved source catalogues have no explicitly identified warning/More time/extension-outcome fixture. Session-expired is terminal and cannot substitute for a warning. A fresh source search or guarded new owned fixture recipe must supply this case before construction.
warning_extension_binding.timer_limit: Labelled design clock/storyboard only; retain at least20s advance warning, 30min inactivity and at least ten extension opportunities; no absolute visitor limit.

limits: Source/control dimensions and parent/property/reaction checks remain a fresh guarded preflight obligation.
Shared recovery specimens have no stream-encoded host identity; they supplement context-specific host evidence and cannot replace four-stream/frame/profile obligations.
Historical names have the eight consumed attempt29 REF repairs applied as expected current names; their current live status requires inspection.
Frame names, reported dimensions and comparison pixels do not establish interactive behavior, actual browser accessibility or complete evidence coverage.

native_timing_source_search.method: Normal Figma Find, query More time, visible This page scope; selected each of the three returned results. No AI/MCP prompt or design edit.
native_timing_source_search.returned_content_kind: Text notes repeating D076 warning/More time obligations; no returned live extension control or warning fixture.
native_timing_source_search.scope_limit: This observed query result does not prove absence under every possible label/filter, hidden source, file or future copy. It supports an unbound-source status, not a complete-page absence claim.

timing_extension_fixture_recipe.standing: Unreviewed design-reference recipe derived from D076/D078 and the current proposed continuation contract. No visitor clock, wire schema, permission, profile or naming grammar is amended; no fixture is constructed.
timing_extension_fixture_recipe.encoding_guard: TL-WARN-EXTEND is the accepted time-limit evidence branch, not a newly invented STATE-WARNING enum. Resolve exact existing host/profile/evidence identity and annotations before any external construction; all new owned IDs remain unassigned.

beginning_of_process.content: This access expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. You can choose More time while access remains active.
beginning_of_process.clock_kind: Explicitly synthetic, acknowledged deadline fixture; no browser/client time authority.

warning.content: Your access is about to expire due to inactivity. Choose More time to continue.
warning.usable_interval: At least 20 seconds before expiry, including the required focus/keyboard/touch inspection path.
warning.focus: In-context warning/status; no invented interrupting modal or focus theft. Explicitly annotate operability and announcement; Figma supplies no actual live-region/AT result.

extend_intent.design_model: One selected process, active attempt and immutable renewal-ticket fixture; no requested duration/client timestamp. Figma uses labels/fixtures only and carries no real proof or ticket.

branches.copy: More time was granted. Your currently confirmed access expiry is shown below.
branches.deadline_rule: Original admitted result is admission plus exactly30 minutes. Display the fresh currently permitted lifetime snapshot, preserving any newer genuine activity; do not replace a newer revision with an older reply.
branches.next: Retain context and readable notice/More time; repeated warning/extension remains possible.

branches.copy: Extra time is not confirmed yet. The last confirmed expiry is shown below.
branches.deadline_rule: No guessed new deadline or grant. Distinguish last confirmed observation from current authority.
branches.next: Explicitly reconcile the same immutable ticket while authority permits; no new extension dispatch from status-check or retry.

branches.copy: This request is out of date. Review the current access status before choosing another action.
branches.deadline_rule: Use only a currently permitted snapshot. A stale ticket is not successful renewal.
branches.next: Retain truthful current state and explicit follow-up; do not infer no effect from an unknown old ticket.

branches.copy: Extra time was not granted. Review the current access status.
branches.deadline_rule: Only current permitted result/snapshot may supply an expiry; no invented duration or automatic success.
branches.next: Offer the allowed smallest safe action; keep End and public recovery distinct.

branches.copy: This access has ended. You can return to the public website or book a conversation.
branches.deadline_rule: Deny extension at or after expiry; no resurrection/backdating. End can win against pending extension.
branches.next: Public recovery or explicit B05 new-session boundary; never automatically restore private process or retired generation.

timing_extension_fixture_recipe.repeat_inspection: A labelled synthetic warning -> deliberate extension -> applied -> warning loop is inspected at least ten times. Ten is a minimum evidence opportunity count, not a maximum policy or absolute conversation limit. Keep distinct branch fixtures for pending/stale/refused/terminal outcomes.
complete_process_guards: More time and readable notice are available from the beginning; a late push or throttled countdown alone cannot introduce them.
A second-by-second countdown is not a live-region announcement stream or clock authority.
Inspect returning from a background tab and unknown-deadline displays; do not fabricate activity or enough usable warning.
Visitor extension cannot renew staff authentication, booking, consent, entitlement or retention.
Terminal generation has no prototype return edge suggesting restored access; prototype reset is labelled a fresh demonstration, not a new granted session.
remaining_before_write: Exact current source or owned host recipe
Evidence-ID/annotation and full relevant allocation bindings
Guarded action/destination and Presentation capability checks
Independent preparation review and applicable exact external-write permission
